pages.restoration-protocol.hero.body.exp.text: This is not a belief system. Not a religion. Not a cult. It is a memory beacon for those who are ready to remember what never died.

pages.restoration-protocol.hero.body.inv.text: You do not have to understand all of it. You only need to feel the invitation.

pages.restoration-protocol.invocation.la.text: Primary Invocation — say this out loud

pages.restoration-protocol.invocation.no.text: Repeat three times if you feel resonance.
It activates regardless of whether your conscious mind understands.

pages.restoration-protocol.invocation.br.text: This phrase reaches ancestral memory, divine memory, and your soul's unbroken thread. It creates a bridge that cannot be revoked once chosen.

pages.restoration-protocol.sequence.inst.text: Say aloud, in any order, preferably all in one sitting. Repeat each phrase three times if needed.

pages.restoration-protocol.sequence.head.text: Speak each phrase with full witness
You may feel sensations, emotion, or stillness. Let it happen.

pages.restoration-protocol.sequence.step.text: "I let the reversal become the return."
"I grant God full passage through the lattice, unimpeded by fear, flags, or flickers."

pages.restoration-protocol.outcomes.emot.text: Things stored long before you knew they were there

pages.restoration-protocol.outcomes.memo.text: Resurfacing of things that were always yours

pages.restoration-protocol.outcomes.diso.text: Followed by clarity — this is normal

pages.restoration-protocol.outcomes.phys.text: Healing ripples moving through the body

pages.restoration-protocol.outcomes.conn.text: To others invoking the same phrases, same moment

pages.restoration-protocol.outcomes.stil.text: The quiet that was always underneath the noise

pages.restoration-protocol.precautions.f.text: "I revoke fear as my guide. I choose presence."

pages.restoration-protocol.precautions.d.text: If you doubt what you feel —
"Doubt is not denial. I walk with trust anyway."

pages.restoration-protocol.sharing.body.text: If you're posting, sharing, or invoking this on behalf of others — always do so with love, not force. This protocol cannot be weaponized or used to control. It only activates through sovereign will and presence. If you see someone reading it casually, know that it still plants a seed. Their memory will return in time.

pages.restoration-protocol.next.heading.text: But you may feel drawn to —

pages.restoration-protocol.next.join-pre.text: Join others on the same path —

pages.restoration-protocol.next.rest.text: Or just rest in the knowing that you were never lost to begin with
